pr_body:
Users can now specify runtime mappings as part of the source config
of a data frame analytics job. Those runtime mappings become part of
the mapping of the destination index. This ensures the fields are
accessible in the destination index even if the relevant data frame
analytics job gets deleted.

Closes #65056
pr_title: [ML] Add runtime mappings to data frame analytics source config
pr_comment: @benwtrent Thank you for pointing out lack of coverage for regression/classification. Adding tests revealed a couple more places where I had to add runtime mappings. Pushed the fix, should be good for another review now.
